note: Rendering geometry for 3D Explore. Not scientific data: visibility states come only from the site export's intervals. Positions are observer-relative metres in the renderer frame x = east, y = up, z = -north; curvature is in the positions once; no vertical exaggeration.

site.name: IM-2 Athena landing point (Mons Mouton region)

observer.source: same point as the site export's terrain_horizon.observer (checked to 1e-6 m)

frame.axes: x = east, y = up, z = -north (right-handed, Y-up), origin at the observer eye
frame.direction_formula: (cos el * sin az, sin el, -cos el * cos az)
frame.local_frame: zenith = site radial unit vector (sphere), east = d/dlon, north = d/dlat (terrain_horizon.enu)
frame.body_frame: Moon ME/DE421 as the LOLA labels (assumed for the site coordinate; see site export)

source_dem.height: DN x 0.5 m above the 1737.4 km sphere; bilinear between pixel centres
source_dem.registration: pixel centres at I = X/s + N/2 + 0.5, J = -Y/s + N/2 + 0.5 (lola.py, terrain_horizon.Raster)

sampling.grid: square grids in polar-stereographic map space aligned to DEM pixel centres; nested levels
sampling.triangulation: cell (i,j): (v00, v01, v10) and (v10, v01, v11); index = j * nx + i
sampling.unmeshed: Terrain beyond the outer square (half-width 30.72 km in map space) is not meshed. The exported skyline profile is computed from terrain to hundreds of km.

levels.kind: bilinear interpolation between pixel centres (no added measured detail)

mesh_check.target_note: 0.05 deg is a proposed rendering target, not a statement of source-data accuracy.

fine_reference.method: terrain_horizon.march on the same LDEM_80S_20M bilinear surface and observer, radial step 1.0 m from 5.0 m to 2000.0 m; azimuths whose profile and fine-march setting points both lie within 1950 m.
fine_reference.interpretation: mesh_minus_fine_reference isolates triangulation/stitching error; fine_reference_minus_profile is the exported profile's own radial-sampling effect (5 m steps cut under sharp crests). Neither is a terrain accuracy.

mesh_check.method: Exact silhouette of the exported triangles (float64 positions before float32 rounding) from the observer, per 0.1 deg azimuth, by triangle / vertical half-plane intersection; compared with terrain_horizon.horizon.elevation_deg of the site export. 'inside' = the profile's setting point lies within the meshed extent in that azimuth (representation error); 'beyond' = it lies outside (incomplete extent).
